info.title: Physics Anatomy API
info.summary: Accounts, sync, live classes, AI and exports for the Physics Anatomy lab.

get.description: Which ways of signing in this server offers, so the page shows only those.

patch.description: A teacher sets the name students see when they join, such as Mr Mensah.

Sign in with the token from an email link. The web page posts it; a GET never signs in.

post.description: Create a class. The teacher confirms the school's permission (ADR 0011); AI starts off.

post.description: Give the class a new code. The old one stops working; students already in stay in.
A one-time personal code for a student who lost their device. Replaces any earlier one.

post.description:
Send one hint to every student whose bench shows this mistake now. Pushing the same
mistake again reaches only those the standing hints have not; if there are none, it returns
the latest hint, so a double click sends one.
An instruction to every student in the class, such as "everyone measure the wire".
A note to one student in the class.
Take back a hint, broadcast or note. Devices hide it if it is still showing.
